## BNK-0557 [建议]
判据: Everyone Pay: Getting Started Guide
提示: ## Access Everyone Pay - Open the app or web dashboard and navigate to Payments. - Select Everyone Pay to view your contacts and recent activity. ## Add your first contacts - Use the Add Contact action and enter a name, username, email, or mobile number. - You can save up to $550 contacts. - Organize contacts with labels and notes to speed up future payments. ## Verify contacts before you send - Contact verification before the first transaction: Yes. - To verify, open the contact card and follow the prompts to confirm the recipient’s details. - Look for a verified indicator on the contact card before sending. ## Configure your preferences - Enable notifications to stay informed about requests, payments, and contact updates. - Review your default funding account and any payment preferences in Settings. ## Safety tips - Verify the recipient details on the confirmation screen every time. - Use trusted contact information saved to your address book rather than retyping. - If something looks off, pause and confirm with the recipient using a separate channel.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_everyone_pay_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0558 [建议]
判据: What is Everyone Pay?
提示: ## Transfer options - Standard transfer: completes within 12 hours once submitted. - Instant transfer: funds are delivered right away for a fee of $0.75 dollars. ## Fees and timing - Standard transfers do not include the instant transfer fee and arrive within the standard processing window of 12 hours. - Instant transfers include a fee of $0.75 dollars and deliver immediately. ## Choosing the right option - Select standard when timing is flexible and you want to avoid instant fees. - Choose instant when the recipient needs funds right away and you accept the fee.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_everyone_pay_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0559 [建议]
判据: How to send and receive money
提示: ## Sending money - Open Everyone Pay and choose a contact from your list or add a new one. - Enter the amount and an optional note visible to the recipient. - Choose delivery speed: - Standard: completes within 12 hours and does not include the instant transfer fee. - Instant: delivers right away and includes a fee of $0.75 dollars or a percentage fee of 0.75% percent, as shown before you confirm. - Review the confirmation screen and submit. ## Receiving money - When someone sends you funds, you receive a notification and a new entry in your activity. - For standard transfers, funds settle within 12 hours after the sender submits. - For instant transfers, funds are delivered immediately and appear in your activity right away. ## Tips for smooth transfers - Verify the contact details on the confirmation screen before submitting. - If you do not recognize a request or payment, decline it and contact support from the transaction details screen. - Keep your contact list current to avoid sending to outdated details.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_everyone_pay_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0560 [建议]
判据: Adding and verifying contacts
提示: ## Add contacts - Go to Everyone Pay and select Add Contact. - Enter a username, email, or mobile number and confirm the contact’s display details. - You can save up to $550 contacts, so consider adding frequent recipients for faster checkout. ## Verify contacts - Contact verification before the first transaction: Yes. - To verify a contact, open their profile and follow the prompts to confirm identity details. - Verified contacts display a clear indicator so you can send with greater confidence. ## Managing your contact list - Edit a contact to update names, labels, or notes. - Remove contacts you no longer use to keep your list organized. - Use search and filters to quickly locate a contact when sending.

判据: Payment processing times
提示: ## Standard transfers - Settle within 12 hours after submission. - Appear as pending until settlement completes. ## Instant transfers - Deliver immediately to the recipient. - Include an instant transfer fee of $0.75 dollars. ## Choosing your speed - Use standard when delivery within the standard window is acceptable. - Use instant when immediate delivery is essential and you accept the fee.

## BNK-0563 [建议]
判据: Canceling a payment
提示: ## When cancellation is possible - You can cancel a payment within 17 minutes of submission if it has not been claimed or posted. ## How to cancel - Open Activity and select the pending payment. - Choose Cancel and confirm. - You will see a cancellation confirmation in your activity once complete. ## If you cannot cancel - The payment may already be claimed, posted, or past the 17 minute window. - If a payment cannot be canceled, consider requesting a return from the recipient or initiating a dispute when appropriate. ## Tips - Double-check recipient details on the confirmation screen to reduce the need for cancellations. - For time-sensitive reversals, act promptly within the available window.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_everyone_pay_007 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0564 [建议]
判据: Disputing a payment
提示: ## When to file a dispute - You believe the payment was unauthorized. - The amount or recipient does not match what you intended. - You encounter suspected fraud or a scam. ## How to start a dispute - Open the transaction from your activity and select Report a problem. - Choose the reason that best describes the issue. - Provide a clear description and attach any supporting evidence such as messages or receipts. - Submit the dispute and monitor status from the transaction thread. ## What to include - Why the payment is incorrect or unauthorized. - Any communications with the recipient. - Screenshots or documents that support your claim. ## What happens next - We review your submission and may contact you for additional details. - If the payment is eligible, we will pursue recovery with the counterparty. - You will receive updates in-app and by email as the case progresses. ## Tips - Act quickly once you notice an issue. - Keep all relevant correspondence until the case is resolved.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_everyone_pay_008 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0565 [建议]
判据: Blocking and unblocking users
提示: ## Block a user - Open the user’s contact card from your contacts or a transaction. - Select More options and choose Block user. - Confirm to prevent the user from sending you requests or payments and to stop you from sending to them. ## Unblock a user - Find the blocked contact in your contacts or privacy settings. - Select Unblock and confirm to restore messaging and payment capabilities. ## What blocking does - Blocks payment requests from the user. - Prevents you from sending payments to the user while blocked. - Hides their activity from your suggestions and search. ## Tips - Use blocking when you no longer wish to interact with a user. - If a user is abusive or fraudulent, block and report the contact from the same menu.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_everyone_pay_009 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0566 [建议]
判据: Common security questions for Everyone Pay
提示: ## Do I need to verify contacts before sending? - Contact verification before the first transaction: Yes. Verification helps ensure you are paying the intended person. ## How do I reduce the risk of sending to the wrong person? - Send only to saved contacts you recognize. - Review the final confirmation screen before submitting. - Look for a verified indicator on the contact profile when available. ## How does Rho handle suspicious activity? - We use risk checks and monitoring to identify unusual patterns. - Transactions may be paused for review if something looks abnormal. ## What should I do if I suspect fraud? - Cancel the payment if it is still pending and eligible for cancellation. - Report the issue from the transaction details and include all relevant information. - Consider blocking the user to prevent further contact.

## BNK-0567 [建议]
判据: Why can't I send money to this contact?
提示: ## Common reasons - The contact has not been verified and your account requires verification before the first transaction: Yes. - You have blocked this user or they have blocked you. - The contact information is invalid or no longer active. - The recipient’s account cannot receive payments at this time. - A security review is temporarily restricting the transfer. ## What you can do - Open the contact card and complete verification if required. - Confirm the contact’s username, email, or mobile number via a trusted channel. - Check your block list and unblock the user if appropriate. - Try again later if you see a temporary restriction message. - If the issue persists, contact support from the failed transaction details.

## BNK-0568 [建议]
判据: Why was my Everyone Pay transaction declined?
提示: ## Limits reached - Individual accounts have a daily limit of $1,500 and a monthly limit of $12,500. If your payment would exceed either limit, it will be declined. ## Other possible causes - Insufficient available balance in the selected funding account. - Invalid or unverified recipient details. - A temporary security review based on unusual activity. - Network or system interruptions during submission. ## How to resolve - Adjust the amount to fit within your remaining daily or monthly capacity. - Confirm recipient details on the contact card and try again. - Select a different funding account if available. - Wait and retry after any temporary restrictions are cleared. - If declines continue, contact support from the transaction screen.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_everyone_pay_012 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0572 [建议]
判据: QR Transfers: Complete Guide
提示: ## Before you start Use this guide to complete a QR transfer end to end, understand timing, and stay within limits. ### Limits and timing - Per transfer cap: You can send up to $1,250 in a single QR payment. - Daily cap: Your total QR payments per day cannot exceed $3,000. - QR validity: A generated QR code remains usable for 17 from the moment it is created. - Confirmation step: Depending on your app settings, Yes determines whether you must approve the payment after scanning. ### Sending a payment via QR - Open the QR payment tool in your app and generate a code for the intended amount. - Share or display the QR to the payer and ensure it is scanned within 17. - If Yes applies, review the recipient and amount carefully and approve to proceed. - Keep the screen steady and bright to help scanners read the code quickly. ### Receiving a payment via QR - Ask the sender to display their QR and scan it using your in-app scanner. - Verify the recipient, amount, and any notes. - If Yes applies, confirm to finalize. ### Managing limits - If a transfer is close to $1,250, reduce the amount so it stays within the cap. - If you reach $3,000, wait until your daily cap resets before attempting additional QR payments. ### Handling expiration - If a code is older than 17, regenerate a fresh QR and try again. - Avoid sharing screenshots of older codes, as they may have already expired. ### Confirmation behavior - When Yes is in effect, use the review screen to double-check the payee name, amount, and any reference details before approving. - If you dismiss or exit during this step, the transfer will not complete.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_qr_transfers_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0573 [建议]
判据: How QR transfers work
提示: ## Transfer flow - A QR code is generated to represent a payment request and remains valid for 17. - The payer scans the QR using the in-app scanner. - The app validates the request details and prepares the payment. - If Yes applies, you will be prompted to review and approve before funds move. - Once approved (or automatically processed if no approval is required), the transfer is initiated. ### QR code lifecycle - Created: The code is generated and starts its validity window of 17. - Scanned: The payer’s app reads the code and loads the payment details. - Confirmed: If Yes is in effect, the payer approves on the confirmation screen. - Completed: Funds move after the app submits the payment. ### When a transfer won’t proceed - The QR is older than 17 and must be regenerated. - You close or dismiss the flow during the review stage when Yes applies. - Connectivity issues interrupt the process before submission. ### Practical tips - Scan promptly to stay within the 17 window. - If prompted, use the Yes review moment to verify details before sending.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_qr_transfers_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0574 [建议]
判据: Scanning and sending payments
提示: ## Scan the QR - Open the QR scanner in your app and point your camera at the code. - Hold the device steady and ensure the code fills most of the frame without cropping. - If the code does not resolve quickly, adjust distance and reduce glare. ## Review and send - Check the recipient and amount displayed after the scan. - Ensure the payment amount does not exceed $1,250. If it does, lower the amount and try again. - If Yes applies, review the details on the confirmation screen and approve to proceed. ## Tips for a smooth scan - Increase on-screen brightness when scanning from another device’s display. - Clean the camera lens and avoid obstructions. - Ask the other party to refresh the QR if it appears unresponsive or outdated.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_qr_transfers_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0575 [建议]
判据: Troubleshooting: QR not scanning
提示: ## Quick checks - Confirm the QR code is still valid. If it was generated longer ago than 17, ask for a new code and try again. - Increase screen brightness on the device displaying the QR to reduce glare and improve contrast. - Wipe your camera lens and hold the device steady; adjust distance to bring the code into focus. ## Environment and device settings - Avoid reflections from glossy screens; tilt the display slightly to remove hotspots. - Ensure camera permissions are enabled for the app. - Close other apps that may be using the camera and retry. ## QR quality - If scanning from a printed code, verify it is not smudged, folded, or low-resolution. - If scanning from a screen, disable any color inversion or display filters that reduce contrast. ## When to regenerate - If the QR has been open for longer than 17 or has been shared as a screenshot and delayed, regenerate a fresh code and scan immediately.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_qr_transfers_004 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0576 [建议]
判据: Why isn't my QR code scanning?
提示: ## Common causes - The code expired because it was generated more than 17 ago. - Screen glare or low brightness is obscuring the pattern. - The camera cannot focus due to distance, motion, or a dirty lens. - The QR is cropped, distorted, or low quality. - Camera permissions for the app are disabled. ## Quick fixes - Regenerate the QR if it may be older than 17. - Increase the display brightness on the device showing the QR and reduce reflections. - Clean your camera lens and adjust the distance until the code is sharp. - Enable camera access in your device settings and reopen the scanner. - Ask for a clearer or unaltered version of the QR if it looks compressed or edited.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_qr_transfers_005 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0577 [建议]
判据: Why did my QR transfer fail?
提示: ## Check limits first - Per-transaction limit: If the amount exceeds $1,250, the transfer will not proceed. Reduce the amount and try again. - Daily limit: If your total QR payments for the day exceed $3,000, you will need to wait until your daily cap resets before sending another QR payment. ## Other common causes - You closed the payment screen before completion. - Connectivity issues interrupted the submission. - The QR data was invalid or damaged when scanned. ## How to resolve - Adjust the amount so it is within $1,250 and resubmit. - If you have reached $3,000, wait for the daily cap to reset and try again. - Keep the app open until you see a success message, and ensure you have a stable connection. - Ask the other party to regenerate a fresh QR if the original appears corrupted or unresponsive.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_qr_transfers_006 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0578 [建议]
判据: Security tips for QR transfers
提示: ## Verify before you send - Use the confirmation screen when Yes applies to review the recipient and amount. Do not approve if anything looks unfamiliar. ## Protect your QR - Share QR codes only with the intended payer and avoid posting them publicly. - Hide or close the QR as soon as the payment is completed to prevent reuse. - Be cautious with screenshots; a copied code can be presented to others. ## Safe scanning habits - Scan QR codes only from trusted sources. Do not scan codes from unknown flyers, messages, or displays you do not trust. - Check for signs of tampering on printed materials, such as stickers placed over original codes. - Use the in-app scanner rather than third-party scanner apps. ## If something looks off - Cancel the payment and verify the details directly with the other party. - Regenerate a new QR and compare details before proceeding. - Keep your app updated to receive the latest security enhancements.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_qr_transfers_007 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0579 [建议]
判据: Scheduled Payments: Complete Guide
提示: ## Key limits | Item | Value | | --- | --- | | Maximum active schedules | 30 | | Minimum days between occurrences | 4 | | Maximum per-payment amount | $3,000 | | Advance notification before charge | 3 | ## Scheduling rules - Ensure at least 4 days between each occurrence when you choose the cadence. - Set the amount at or below $3,000 for every occurrence. - You can maintain up to 30 active schedules at any time. - You will receive a reminder 3 days before each occurrence so you can verify details and available funds. ## Managing active schedules - Review your list of active schedules to confirm upcoming dates and amounts. - If you have reached 30, cancel an existing schedule before creating a new one. - If you need to change timing so that occurrences are properly spaced, adjust the cadence to respect the 4 requirement. ## Notifications and confirmations - Expect a notification 3 days prior to each scheduled payment. Use this reminder to double-check recipient details and your balance. - After each payment processes, verify the debit and confirmation in your activity to ensure it matches the scheduled amount (not exceeding $3,000). ## Best practices - Choose a cadence that naturally respects at least 4 days between occurrences to avoid schedule errors. - Keep your available balance ready by the time you receive the 3-day reminder. - If you need multiple schedules (e.g., different recipients), track how many are active so you do not exceed 30.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_scheduled_payments_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0580 [建议]
判据: Setting up recurring payments
提示: ## Before you begin - Confirm you have not reached your limit of active schedules: 30. - Decide on an amount that does not exceed $3,000. - Plan a cadence that respects at least 4 days between occurrences. ## Create a new recurring payment - Select the recipient. - Enter the payment amount up to $3,000. - Choose the start date and cadence ensuring the gap between occurrences is at least 4 days. - Review the summary and confirm. ## Tips for avoiding setup errors - If the amount exceeds $3,000, reduce the amount before saving. - If the cadence attempts to schedule occurrences too close together, increase the interval so there are at least 4 days between payments. - If you already have 30 active, cancel an existing schedule before adding a new one. ## Verifying your schedule - Check that the first and subsequent occurrences align with your intended timing and comply with the 4 rule. - Confirm that the recurring amount remains at or below $3,000 for all future occurrences.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_scheduled_payments_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0581 [建议]
判据: Editing or canceling a scheduled payment
提示: ## Edit options - You can change the amount, next occurrence date, or cadence for future payments. - Editing is locked within 13 hours of the upcoming occurrence. Changes made after that window take effect on later occurrences. ## How to edit - Open the scheduled payment. - Update the fields you need to change. - Save your changes. If you are within 13 hours of the next occurrence, you will need to wait until it processes to see the updates apply. ## Canceling a scheduled payment - Open the schedule and select Cancel. - Confirm the cancellation to stop future occurrences. - If the next occurrence is very near, it may still process even after you cancel. Editing remains locked within 13 hours, and cancellation may not affect an occurrence that has already begun processing. ## After you edit or cancel - Review your schedule list to confirm the new details or the canceled status. - If you edited near the 13-hour window, verify which occurrence the change affected.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_scheduled_payments_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0582 [建议]
判据: Using Everyone Pay for rent or allowance
提示: ## Setting amounts - Choose an amount that fits your rent or allowance plan and ensure it is at or below $3,000. - For rent, confirm the recurring amount matches your agreed payment. If your rent exceeds $3,000, adjust the approach so each scheduled payment does not surpass that limit. ## Timing recommendations - Set the schedule so payments arrive before the due date your recipient expects. - Use the reminder you receive 3 days before each occurrence to verify funds and make any needed adjustments for future cycles. ## Staying organized - Label the schedule clearly (e.g., Rent or Allowance) so it is easy to manage alongside other commitments. - Use the 3-day reminder to confirm that the amount still aligns with your current rent or allowance agreement. ## After each payment - Check your activity to confirm that the processed amount matches what you scheduled and does not exceed $3,000. - If changes are needed for future payments, schedule them in advance so they take effect before the next reminder arrives 3 days ahead.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_scheduled_payments_004 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0583 [建议]
判据: Troubleshooting: payment didn't go through
提示: ## Immediate checks - Confirm you had sufficient available funds at the time of processing. - Verify the recipient details are current and accurate. - Ensure the scheduled amount complies with applicable limits. - Check whether the scheduled date fell on a day your funding method could process payments. ## Auto-retry behavior - If Yes is enabled, the system will attempt the payment again up to 3 times. - When a retry is pending, add funds and keep them available until the next attempt. ## After the final attempt - If all 3 attempts fail, the occurrence will not process. - Review and adjust your schedule or amount for future occurrences, and ensure funds are available ahead of the next scheduled date. ## Common causes and fixes - Insufficient funds: Add funds and, if Yes is enabled, wait for a retry. - Recipient issues: Confirm the recipient information or request updated details. - Amount limits: Reduce the scheduled amount to comply with limits. - Timing conflicts: Move the next occurrence to a date that can process normally. ## Getting help - If you still cannot identify the cause, capture any error messages shown and reach out through in-app support with the schedule name and the date the payment was supposed to process.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_scheduled_payments_005 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0584 [建议]
判据: Why didn't my scheduled payment go through?
提示: ## Possible reasons - Insufficient available funds at the time of processing. - Recipient details were invalid or out of date. - The scheduled amount did not meet policy limits. - The schedule date conflicted with processing availability. ## What happens next - If Yes is enabled, the system will try again up to 3 times. - Add funds and keep them available until the next attempt, then monitor for confirmation. ## How to resolve - Verify and update recipient information. - Adjust the amount to comply with limits. - Move the next occurrence to a date that aligns with processing availability. - If all 3 attempts fail, review your schedule settings and create a new occurrence after correcting the issue.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_scheduled_payments_006 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0585 [建议]
判据: Why can't I edit my scheduled payment?
提示: ## Editing lock window - Editing is restricted within 13 hours of the scheduled time. During this window, changes to amount, date, or cadence are not allowed. ## How to proceed - If you are inside the 13-hour window, wait for the upcoming occurrence to process, then edit the schedule for future occurrences. - If you need to prevent future payments, cancel the schedule instead; changes take effect on upcoming occurrences that have not begun processing. ## Tips - Plan changes ahead of the 13-hour cutoff so they apply to the next occurrence. - After making edits outside the lock window, review the schedule summary to confirm the effective date of your changes.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_scheduled_payments_007 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0586 [建议]
判据: How do I stop a recurring payment?
提示: ## Cancel the schedule - Open the scheduled payment and choose Cancel. - Confirm the cancellation to stop future occurrences. ## Timing considerations - If you cancel close to the scheduled time, the next occurrence may still process if it has already begun. Editing is locked within 13 hours, and cancellation requests made very close to processing time may not stop the imminent occurrence. ## Verify the outcome - Check your list of schedules to ensure the status is canceled. - Monitor your activity around the scheduled date to confirm whether the imminent occurrence processed, then confirm that no further occurrences are set. ## Restarting later - When you are ready to resume, create a new schedule with your preferred amount and timing.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_scheduled_payments_008 | 话题: banking operations manual

A send must be under your remaining daily allowance and your remaining monthly allowance. - If either remaining allowance is insufficient, the send will be declined. ### Viewing your current limit availability - Check your Everyone Pay send screen to see remaining daily and monthly availability before confirming a payment. - If you are close to your limit, consider scheduling the payment for a later date. ### Requesting a higher limit - You can submit a limit increase request from your account settings. - Typical review time: up to 4 days. - Provide context in your request, such as the purpose of payments and anticipated frequency, to help expedite review. ### Practical tips - Plan larger disbursements across multiple days if needed to stay within your daily cap. - Track cumulative activity so you do not exhaust your monthly capacity early. - If you regularly reach your cap, request a permanent increase rather than relying on one-off workarounds.

## BNK-0588 [建议]
判据: Sending limits — per day and month
提示: ## Your per-day and per-month caps - New accounts: - Daily: $750 - Monthly: $7,500 - Verified accounts: - Daily: $3,500 - Monthly: $35,000 ### How they interact - A payment must fit under your remaining daily cap and your remaining monthly cap. - Reaching the daily cap stops additional sends for the rest of the day, even if you still have monthly capacity. - Reaching the monthly cap stops additional sends for the rest of the month, even if you have daily capacity on a given day. ### Tips - Space out higher-value sends to avoid hitting the daily cap. - Monitor cumulative activity to preserve monthly capacity for end-of-month needs.

## BNK-0589 [建议]
判据: What is Everyone Pay?
提示: ## A focused definition Everyone Pay is Rho-Bank’s payment capability for sending funds to individuals or businesses from your account. ### How limits apply to Everyone Pay - New accounts start with a daily cap of $750. - New accounts start with a monthly cap of $7,500. - Both caps apply at the same time; a send must be within your remaining daily and monthly capacity. ### What to expect when you start - Your available amount updates after each completed send. - If you reach either cap, you can resume sending when the relevant period renews or after an approved limit adjustment.

## BNK-0590 [建议]
判据: Why did I reach my sending limit?
提示: ## Common reasons you hit a limit - You reached your daily cap for new accounts: $750. - You reached your monthly cap for new accounts: $7,500. - Multiple smaller payments collectively used up your remaining allowance for the period. - A payment you just completed reduced your available capacity below the amount you attempted to send next. ### How to confirm - Check your Everyone Pay screen to view remaining daily and monthly availability. - Review recent outgoing payments to see how they contributed to your totals. ### What you can do next - Wait for the relevant period to renew and try again. - Reduce the amount and send within your remaining allowance. - Submit a request for a higher limit if you need additional capacity on an ongoing basis.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_sending_limits_004 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0591 [建议]
判据: How do I increase my Everyone Pay sending limit?
提示: ## Request a higher limit - Open account settings and choose the option to request a limit increase. - Describe your typical payment volumes, purpose, and the limit you are seeking. - Allow up to 4 days for review and processing. ### Temporary boosts - If you need a short-term increase for a specific payment or event, request a temporary boost. - Temporary boosts can be approved up to 30.0% of your current limit, subject to review. ### Automatic increases - Automatic increases based on account history: Yes. - When True, your limit may grow over time with positive usage and account standing. - When False, you will need to submit requests for any changes. ### Tips for faster approval - Ensure your profile information and documentation are current. - Provide clear business or personal context for expected payment flows. - Request only the capacity you reasonably need.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_sending_limits_005 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0592 [建议]
判据: Why can't I send more than $500 per day?
提示: ## The most likely reasons - Your account is subject to the default daily cap of $750. - You attempted to send an amount that exceeds your remaining daily allowance after earlier payments today. ### How to resolve it - Verify your account to qualify for a higher daily cap of up to $3,500 (subject to approval). - Send a smaller amount that fits within your remaining daily allowance. - Wait for your daily period to renew and complete the remaining amount then. ### Keep in mind - Daily and monthly caps work together; even if the daily cap allows a payment, your monthly cap might not.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_sending_limits_006 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0593 [建议]
判据: What's the difference between daily and monthly limits?
提示: ## Side-by-side comparison | Limit type | Applies to | New accounts | Verified accounts | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Daily | Total you can send in a single day | $750 | $3,500 | | Monthly | Total you can send in a single month | $7,500 | $35,000 | ### How they work together - Both limits are enforced at the same time. - Even if you have daily capacity left, a payment will be declined if it exceeds your remaining monthly capacity. - Large one-time payments can be constrained by the daily cap even when ample monthly capacity remains. ### Planning tips - For sizable disbursements, check both remaining daily and monthly availability. - Consider splitting larger amounts across multiple days if the daily cap is the binding constraint. - If you frequently run into either cap, request an adjustment to align with your typical payment needs.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_sending_limits_007 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0594 [建议]
判据: Split-the-Bill: Complete Guide
提示: ## Key limits and timelines - Maximum participants per group: 30 - Maximum total amount that can be split: $5,500 - Payment due date after creation: 16 - Automatic reminder cadence: every 4 ### Creating and sending a split - Confirm the total you intend to split is at or below $5,500. If it exceeds this limit, reduce the total or break it into multiple splits. - Add participants up to the cap of 30. You can invite fewer; you cannot exceed this cap. - Set each member’s share according to your preferred method, then review and send the request. ### Tracking collection status - After sending, monitor each participant’s status in the split details. You’ll see who has paid and who is outstanding. - Automatic reminders go out on a recurring basis every 4. You can also nudge members manually if needed. ### Due dates and what happens next - Each member’s payment is due within 16 from creation. - Before the due date, outstanding members will continue to receive reminders at the 4 interval. - If the due date passes, review outstanding balances and decide whether to extend, resend, or resolve the split. ### Adjustments and edge cases - If the total approaches $5,500, consider removing optional items or creating separate splits. - If you reach 30 but still need to include others, create an additional split. - Use the activity view to confirm whether reminders have gone out according to the 4 schedule and whether the 16 window is approaching.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_split-the-bill_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0595 [建议]
判据: Setting up a group payment
提示: ## Prepare your group - List the participants you plan to include and ensure the group will not exceed 30. - Gather contact details so each member can receive their request without delay. ### Choose how to split - Equal shares: Assign the same amount to each participant. - Unequal shares: This is controlled by Yes. If enabled, assign custom amounts per person. - Percentage-based: This is controlled by Yes. If enabled, allocate shares by percentages that add up to the total. ### Build the split - Add participants up to 30. - Select the split method based on Yes and Yes. - Enter each participant’s share, verify the total, and attach a clear description so everyone understands what they owe. ### Review and send - Confirm all participant details are accurate. - Double-check shares match your chosen method and that totals reconcile. - Send the split to start tracking responses and payments immediately.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_split-the-bill_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0596 [建议]
判据: Managing group balances
提示: ## View and interpret statuses - Open the split details to see each member’s owed amount and whether it has been paid. - Use the activity timeline to confirm when reminders were sent and whether messages align with the 4 interval. ### Reminder cadence - Automatic reminders are issued every 4 until the due date. - If a member indicates they plan to pay soon, you can allow the schedule to continue rather than sending additional manual nudges. ### Due dates and follow-up - Payments are due within 16 from when the split was created. - As the due date nears, consider a direct message to any outstanding members to avoid last-minute issues. - If the due date passes and balances remain, decide whether to continue reminders, adjust shares, or close and recreate the split as appropriate. ### Practical tips - Reconcile partial payments promptly so remaining balances reflect accurate amounts. - If a member claims they paid, check their status in the split details and the timing against the 4 schedule and 16 window.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_split-the-bill_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0597 [建议]
判据: Splitting restaurant or rent bills
提示: ## Confirm the total and approach - Verify the total you plan to split is within $5,500. If it exceeds this, reduce the total or separate the split. - Choose a split method appropriate to the bill type: - Restaurants: Consider itemized or percentage-based shares if available through Yes or Yes. - Rent: Consider fixed shares (equal or custom) based on room size or agreements; use Yes if members owe different amounts. ### Using unequal or percentage-based splits - Unequal splits are controlled by Yes. If enabled, assign specific amounts per person to reflect items ordered or agreed rent shares. - Percentage-based splits are controlled by Yes. If enabled, allocate percentages to align with consumption or lease terms. ### Review before sending - Confirm the sum of all shares equals the total and remains under $5,500. - Add clear notes so each participant understands their portion and the reason for their share. ### After sending - Monitor responses and adjust only if participants agree to changes. For large restaurant tabs or shared housing expenses, keep documentation handy to resolve questions about allocations.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_split-the-bill_004 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0598 [建议]
判据: Troubleshooting: uncollected payments
提示: ## Understand timing - Payments are due within 16 of creation. Before the deadline, outstanding members will continue to receive reminders every 4. ### If the deadline has not passed - Confirm that automatic reminders align with the 4 schedule. - Send a courteous manual reminder to clarify the amount and purpose. - Check that the participant’s contact details are correct and that they were included in the split. ### If the deadline has passed - Review the split details to confirm who is still outstanding relative to the 16 window. - Consider whether to extend the arrangement by recreating the split or reissuing requests. - Communicate any consequences or next steps clearly so members understand expectations. ### Reduce friction going forward - Provide a concise description for the split so members recognize the charge. - Give early notice before the 16 cutoff and reference the reminder cadence of 4 so participants know when to expect follow-ups.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_split-the-bill_005 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0599 [建议]
判据: Why hasn't my group member paid yet?
提示: ## Timing-related reasons - The payment may still be within the allowed window of 16. Members often wait until closer to the due date. - They might not have received the most recent automatic reminder yet if the 4 interval has not elapsed. ### What you can check - Confirm the member is listed in the split and that their contact details are correct. - Verify the reminder timeline shows messages sent at the 4 cadence. - Look at the creation timestamp to see how far you are into the 16 period. ### Helpful next steps - Send a polite manual reminder referencing the purpose of the split and the due date within 16. - If they request more time, consider closing and recreating the split with expectations aligned to the 4 cycle. - Keep notes in the split description so all members have the same context.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_split-the-bill_006 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0600 [建议]
判据: Why can't I create a split payment?
提示: ## Hard limits that block creation - Group size exceeds the maximum of 30. Reduce the participant list or create multiple groups. - Total amount exceeds $5,500. Lower the total or split it into separate requests. ### Other common blockers - Missing required details for one or more participants, such as contact information. - The description or allocations are incomplete or do not add up to the total. - You are attempting to add the same participant multiple times. ### How to proceed - Trim the participant list to stay within 30. - Adjust the total so it does not exceed $5,500 and ensure all shares reconcile to that total. - Recheck participant details, then try creating the split again.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_split-the-bill_007 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0601 [建议]
判据: How do I remove someone from a split payment?
提示: ## Before you remove a participant - Confirm whether the participant has already paid. If so, plan how you will reallocate or refund before removing them. - Check your current participant count to understand how removal affects your group relative to the 30 cap. ### Remove a participant - Open the split details and locate the participant you want to remove. - Select the option to remove them and confirm your choice. - Review remaining allocations so the total is still accurate after removal. ### After removal - If the participant had an outstanding request, confirm it has been canceled. - Reallocate the removed share among remaining members and verify that the total remains consistent. - If you need to add a replacement, you can invite another participant as long as the total count stays at or below 30. ### Tips - Communicate the change to the group so everyone understands any updated allocations. - Keep a brief note in the split description to document why the participant was removed.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_split-the-bill_008 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0602 [建议]
判据: User Blocking: Complete Guide
提示: ## What happens when you block someone - Blocking prevents blocked users from sending payment requests: Yes. - Blocked users are notified they have been blocked: Yes. ## Limits and timing - Maximum number of users you can block: $275. - If you unblock someone, you must wait 12 hours before you can block the same user again. ## How to block a user - Open the user profile you want to block. - Choose the option to block the user and confirm. - The user will immediately be added to your block list, subject to the limit of $275. ## How to unblock a user - Open your block list and select the user you want to unblock. - Choose the option to unblock and confirm. - If needed, remember that re-blocking the same user requires waiting 12 hours. ## Quick reference | Item | Policy | | --- | --- | | Maximum blocked users | $275 | | Re-block cooldown | 12 hours | | Payment requests prevented by blocking | Yes | | Block notification sent to the user | Yes | ## Troubleshooting - If you cannot block someone, check whether you have reached $275. - If you recently unblocked the same user, wait 12 hours before attempting to block again. - Verify you are blocking the correct profile, especially if there are similar names or duplicate profiles.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_user_blocking_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0603 [建议]
判据: Blocking and unblocking users
提示: ## Blocking a user - Navigate to the user profile you want to block. - Select the option to block and confirm your choice. - If blocking fails, verify you have not reached the maximum of $275. ## Unblocking a user - Go to your block list and choose the user you wish to unblock. - Confirm unblocking to restore normal interactions. - After unblocking, if you decide to block the same user again, you must wait 12 hours. ## Tips for managing your block list - Periodically review your block list to ensure you stay within the limit of $275. - If you need to block a new user but are at capacity, consider unblocking users you no longer need to restrict and note the 12 hours re-block window for any recently unblocked users.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_user_blocking_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0604 [建议]
判据: Common security questions for Everyone Pay
提示: ## Do blocks prevent payment requests? - Blocking prevents blocked users from sending payment requests: Yes. ## Are blocked users notified? - Blocked users are notified they have been blocked: Yes. ## What should I do if I still receive activity from a blocked user? - Confirm the user is on your block list and that the profile matches exactly. - If the activity appears to come from a different profile, block that profile as well. - If the behavior persists, contact support and include screenshots of the activity and the profile you blocked.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_user_blocking_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0605 [建议]
判据: Why can't I block this user?
提示: ## Common reasons - You may have reached the maximum number of users you can block: $275. - The profile may already be on your block list under a similar or duplicate name. - The profile you are trying to block may not be eligible to be blocked due to account status or compliance restrictions. - The profile might not match the user you intend to block; confirm the username and associated details. - A temporary service issue may be preventing the action; try again later. ## What you can do - Review your block list and remove users you no longer need to restrict to free up space if you are at $275. - Verify the exact profile before attempting to block. - If blocking remains unavailable, capture a screenshot of any error message and contact support.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_user_blocking_004 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0606 [建议]
判据: How do I unblock someone I previously blocked?
提示: ## Unblock steps - Open your block list from your settings or privacy controls. - Select the user you want to unblock and confirm. ## After unblocking - If you change your mind, you must wait 12 hours before you can block the same user again. - Review your interactions with the unblocked user to ensure they align with your preferences. ## Tips - Keep a note of when you unblocked someone if you plan to re-block, so you can track the 12 hours window. - If you cannot find the user in your block list, confirm you are viewing the correct account or profile.
出处: tau2doc:doc_everyone_pay_user_blocking_005 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0607 [建议]
判据: Can blocked users still send me payment requests?
提示: ## Answer - Blocking prevents blocked users from sending payment requests: Yes. ## What to do next - If you want to ensure no requests are received, confirm the user is on your block list and that the block is active. - If requests appear to come from a different profile, block that profile as well and report any suspicious activity.
